column3: Vejeeta couldn't either, for two hundred and fifty episodes. And the reason isn't weakness.
His people wear a scouter. It turns a person into a number. When Goku's number came back too high, Vejeeta crushed it.
A classic theory says we all carry one. With no ruler for how good we are, we measure against people close to our level.
And a review of sixty years of experiments found we mostly look up, and it usually leaves us feeling smaller.
That isn't a flaw. It's your mind, taking a measurement. And until you see that,
